item.title: SCV 101: Nedra & Steven Barlow, NOLA Med Transport
item.description: On this episode of SCV 101, host Bill Miranda chats with Nedra and Steven Barlow, co-owners of NOLA Med Transport, to talk about why the decided to start a med transport business in 2024 in Santa Clarita. They also discuss some of the issues that individuals who have trouble receiving reliable transport face and how they help to fill in that need.
